limitations: Only Pass rows were executed successfully through the external desktop driver.
Reference fixture creation is not UI workflow coverage.
No genuine messages, physical printing, production records or live upgrades.
Only the current desktop resolution and DPI are exercised unless an explicit matrix is recorded.
Scoped blocked rows were not converted to passes; an executed later outcome replaces only its matching catalog scenario.
The full financial/promotion run precedes the final admission toolbar-only fix; admission CRUD/navigation and visual regression were repeated afterward.

Broader history/statement filter combinations, complete permission/keyboard matrices, supported delete flows, write-interruption/concurrency and large-data/endurance testing are not certified by this 48-case catalog.
